resources.string: Let\'s make this TV yours. A few questions, and the home screen shapes itself around you.
For the greeting and the weather.

Pick the ones you subscribe to: the home screen recommends from them and opens titles there.
Their matches get a reminder and a live score over anything you watch.
Teams (comma separated), e.g. Barcelona, Al Hilal
Pick a few: recommendations lean toward them.
Free, and they stay on this TV. Without them the parts that need one stay hidden. You can add them later in Settings.
Shamash becomes the home screen and screensaver, and the TV maker\'s promo apps are turned off (never uninstalled). Settings › Home screen › Original brings everything back.
console.cloud.google.com › Credentials › OAuth client ID › TVs and Limited Input devices
The TV\'s own settings: picture, sound, network, accounts.
Go through the first-run questions again: name, city, apps, teams, tastes.
The TV\'s original home screen is in use.

Signed in. Recommended for you is on.

A full app for Cinemana\'s catalog, with its rows on Home.
What each of the remote\'s app buttons opens.
Apps left running when you go back Home, so they resume instantly. The others are closed to free memory.
On the TV: allow debugging, tick “Always allow”, then OK.
Bringing back the original home screen…
Shamash is your home screen. %1$d apps turned off.
Kept on because they saved your Wi-Fi: %1$s
Back to the original home screen. %1$d apps turned on.
Nothing was changed: the TV\'s setup saved your Wi-Fi network. In Settings › Network & Internet, forget the network, join it again, then try again.
Turn on USB debugging (and Network debugging if listed) in the TV\'s Developer options, then try again.
The TV\'s debugging didn\'t answer. Turn USB debugging off and on, then try again.
The TV\'s “Allow debugging?” wasn\'t accepted. Try again and choose Allow.
The TV refused Shamash\'s key. Revoke USB debugging authorizations in Developer options, then try again.
Only Wireless debugging is on. Turn on USB debugging (or Network debugging) too.
The TV answered in an unexpected way. Try again.
The TV refused a command. Nothing more was changed.
Shamash couldn\'t save its key. Try again.
Android refused Shamash as the home screen. Nothing else was changed.
An unexpected app name was skipped for safety. Nothing was changed.
Shamash couldn\'t check which apps saved your Wi-Fi, so nothing was changed. Try again.
Something unexpected went wrong. Try again, or choose Original to undo what was done.
Lets the remote\'s Netflix, YouTube and Prime buttons open the app you chose in Shamash. Reads only those buttons.
